title: Abortion Goes to the Supreme Court (Again)

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带上300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满美感、拥有50年历史文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In overturning Roe v.
sentences.zh: 去年最高法院推翻“罗诉韦德案”时，

sentences.en: Wade last year, the Supreme Court's message was that it was done with the issue of abortion.
sentences.zh: 其传达的信息是它已经处理完了堕胎问题。

sentences.en: It wasn't.
sentences.zh: 事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Today, Adam Liptak on the case that is forcing the high court to weigh in on abortion all over again.
sentences.zh: 今天，亚当·利普塔克将带我们了解这起迫使最高法院再次审议堕胎问题的案件。

sentences.en: Wednesday, April 19th.
sentences.zh: 4月19日，星期三。

sentences.en: So, Adam, here we are once again, you and me, talking about abortion and the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 那么，亚当，我们又见面了，你和我，再次谈论堕胎和最高法院。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I thought when we talked about the big decision in June in Dobbs overturning Roe v.
sentences.zh: 我本以为当我们谈论六月份推翻“罗诉韦德案”的重大裁决时，

sentences.en: Wade, that the Supreme Court had kind of made us a promise that it was getting out of the abortion business and that the fight over abortion would now be political, not legal.
sentences.zh: 最高法院算是向我们承诺过它将不再插手堕胎事务，关于堕胎的斗争将是政治性的，而非法律性的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And yet, this issue has already made its way back up to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个问题已经再次闹到了最高法院。

sentences.en: So, tell us why that has happened.
sentences.zh: 所以，告诉我们为什么会发生这种情况。

sentences.en: So, opponents of abortion won, of course, an enormous victory last June.
sentences.zh: 反堕胎人士当然在去年六月取得了巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: And the upshot of that victory was that Roe v.
sentences.zh: 那场胜利的结果是“罗诉韦德案”被推翻，

sentences.en: Wade was overturned and in much of the country, abortion became illegal, but not in all of the country.
sentences.zh: 在美国大部分地区，堕胎变得非法，但并非全国皆然。

sentences.en: And opponents of abortion wanted it to be legal nowhere.
sentences.zh: 而反堕胎人士希望它在任何地方都不合法。

sentences.en: And they hit upon a strategy to go after the most common method of abortion in places where it's still legal, which is the use of abortion pills, notably one called mifepristone.
sentences.zh: 于是他们想出了一个策略，针对在堕胎仍合法的地区最常用的堕胎方法，也就是使用堕胎药，特别是米非司酮。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A drug that, as we've explained on the show in the past, is used in about half of all abortions in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 正如我们过去在节目中解释过的，这种药物在美国约一半的堕胎手术中被使用。

sentences.en: But remind us how exactly these anti-abortion groups try to go after this drug.
sentences.zh: 但请提醒我们，这些反堕胎组织究竟是如何试图针对这种药物的？

sentences.en: Well, some groups of doctors and individual doctors who oppose abortion go into federal court in Amarillo, Texas.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一些反对堕胎的医生团体和个人医生向德克萨斯州阿马里洛的联邦法院提起了诉讼。

sentences.en: They do a bit of judge shopping.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了一番“法官购物”。

sentences.en: There's only one judge in Amarillo, Texas, federal judge, Matthew Kazmarek.
sentences.zh: 在德克萨斯州阿马里洛只有一位联邦法官，马修·卡兹马雷克。

sentences.en: And they make the argument to him that the Food and Drug Administration, 23 years ago in 2000,
sentences.zh: 他们向他提出论点，称食品药品监督管理局（FDA）在23年前的2000年，

sentences.en: had relied on bad science to approve this drug and that the judge should step in and take the extraordinary step of suspending the approval of this abortion bill.
sentences.zh: 是基于错误的科学批准了这种药物，法官应该介入并采取暂停批准这种堕胎药的非常规举措。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: These groups want this medicine off the market entirely, and they think this is the judge who's going to make that happen.
sentences.zh: 这些组织希望这种药彻底退出市场，他们认为这位法官就是能实现这一目标的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he holds a hearing, hears the arguments, and a little while later issues precisely the decision opponents of abortion were hoping for,
sentences.zh: 他举行了听证会，听取了辩论，不久后就发布了反堕胎人士所期望的裁决，

sentences.en: saying he would suspend the availability of the drug.
sentences.zh: 称他将暂停该药物的供应。

sentences.en: And his decision is widely criticized.
sentences.zh: 他的裁决受到了广泛批评。

sentences.en: Many people think it's flawed.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为它是有缺陷的。

sentences.en: And why exactly?
sentences.zh: 具体是因为什么？

sentences.en: Where to begin?
sentences.zh: 从何说起呢？

sentences.en: There's a very significant question about whether these abortion opponents had legal standing to sue,
sentences.zh: 关于这些反堕胎人士是否有权提起诉讼，存在一个非常重大的疑问，

sentences.en: whether they themselves had suffered the sort of direct and concrete injury that gives them standing to sue.
sentences.zh: 即他们自己是否遭受了那种赋予他们诉讼资格的直接且具体的伤害。

sentences.en: Their claim is that some of them are emergency room doctors,
sentences.zh: 他们的主张是，他们中有些人是急诊室医生，

sentences.en: and some of them might someday be in an emergency room where the rare thing of a complication induced by this abortion bill causes a woman to have to go to an emergency room,
sentences.zh: 有些人可能有一天会在急诊室遇到罕见的情况，即因这种堕胎药引起的并发症导致女性必须去急诊室，

sentences.en: and they will have to treat that woman, and they won't want to do that.
sentences.zh: 而他们将不得不治疗该女性，但他们不想这样做。

sentences.en: And that chain of causation, legal experts say, does not satisfy ordinary understandings of standing.
sentences.zh: 法律专家表示，这种因果链条并不符合对诉讼资格的常规理解。

sentences.en: Because it's very theoretical rather than a case being brought by people who have actually suffered the harm.
sentences.zh: 因为它非常理论化，而不是由真正遭受伤害的人提起的诉讼。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there are Supreme Court cases that say as much, that even a statistically likely prospect of future harm doesn't do it.
sentences.zh: 最高法院也有案例支持这一点，即即使是统计学上可能发生的未来伤害也不足以构成诉讼资格。

sentences.en: Okay, so a shaky start.
sentences.zh: 好吧，看来是个不稳的开端。

sentences.en: What else about the decision is considered less than pristine?
sentences.zh: 关于这个裁决，还有什么被认为是不够严谨的？

sentences.en: There's a statute of limitations for challenges to drugs of six years.
sentences.zh: 对于药物挑战存在六年的诉讼时效。

sentences.en: The drug was approved in 2000, and I'm not great at math, but 23 is larger than six.
sentences.zh: 该药于2000年获批，我数学不太好，但23显然大于6。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: So there's a real statute of limitations problem.
sentences.zh: 所以存在一个真正的诉讼时效问题。

sentences.en: And then there's the largest problem of all, a conceptual problem, about who should be making the decisions about whether drugs are safe and effective.
sentences.zh: 然后是最大的问题，一个概念性问题，即谁应该决定药物是否安全有效。

sentences.en: We have, on the one hand, an expert agency, the Food and Drug Administration, which has gone through extensive study and approved the drug.
sentences.zh: 一方面，我们有一个专家机构，食品药品监督管理局，它经过了广泛的研究并批准了该药。

sentences.en: And on the other hand, we have a federal judge in Texas who is re-evaluating that evidence for himself, although as far as I know, he has no particular scientific training.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，我们有一位德克萨斯州的联邦法官，他正在亲自重新评估这些证据，尽管据我所知，他并没有特别的科学背景。

sentences.en: And he's also relying on some studies that critics have real problems with, including collections of blog posts.
sentences.zh: 而且他所依赖的一些研究也让批评者感到非常困扰，其中包括一些博客文章的集合。

sentences.en: So it does not seem to be peer-reviewed science we're getting here.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来并不是我们所期望的同行评审科学。

sentences.en: But nonetheless, Judge Matthew Kaczmarek comes to the conclusion that the FDA was wrong in the year 2000 to approve this drug.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，马修·卡兹马雷克法官还是得出了FDA在2000年批准该药是错误的结论。

sentences.en: So in multiple meaningful ways, this Texas federal judge's ruling feels shaky, maybe even a little bit shoddy.
sentences.zh: 所以从多个重要方面来看，这位德克萨斯州联邦法官的裁决显得站不住脚，甚至有点粗制滥造。

sentences.en: But here it is.
sentences.zh: 但它确实存在。

sentences.en: He's a federal judge.
sentences.zh: 他是一位联邦法官。

sentences.en: His ruling has consequences.
sentences.zh: 他的裁决是有后果的。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, the judge had some choices about what to do about his decision while the inevitable appeals were going to happen.
sentences.zh: 嗯，法官在不可避免的上诉过程中，对于如何处理他的裁决有一些选择。

sentences.en: He could have put the decision on pause to give the litigants and higher courts ample time in a deliberate way to consider whether his ruling was right or not.
sentences.zh: 他本可以暂停该裁决，给诉讼当事人和上级法院充足的时间，以审慎的方式考虑他的裁决是否正确。

sentences.en: Instead, he gives the world a seven-day deadline.
sentences.zh: 相反，他给了世界一个七天的最后期限。

sentences.en: His ruling is going to come into effect in a week unless a higher court does something to stop it.
sentences.zh: 除非上级法院采取行动阻止，否则他的裁决将在一周内生效。

sentences.en: And that thing that will happen in just a week is that Mifepristone would be taken off the market, a very serious, very significant change.
sentences.zh: 而一周后将发生的事情是，米非司酮将被撤出市场，这是一个非常严重、非常重大的改变。

sentences.en: Yes, it would cause chaos in the marketplace.
sentences.zh: 是的，这会导致市场混乱。

sentences.en: And so what is the reaction to this very aggressive timetable from this Texas judge?
sentences.zh: 那么对于这位德克萨斯法官如此激进的时间表，各方有何反应？

sentences.en: There's reaction all over the place.
sentences.zh: 各方反应不一。

sentences.en: This is a breathtaking example of judicial aggressiveness.
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人震惊的司法激进主义例子。

sentences.en: First of all, the decision itself is the subject of really harsh criticism from across the ideological spectrum.
sentences.zh: 首先，该裁决本身就受到了来自不同意识形态阵营的严厉批评。

sentences.en: The ruling reads like somebody who is a anti-abortion activiSt.
sentences.zh: 这份裁决读起来就像出自一位反堕胎活动家之手。

sentences.en: I think there are problems with the judge's ruling, but I don't think that's because of his religious beliefs.
sentences.zh: 我认为这位法官的裁决有问题，但我认为这并非源于他的宗教信仰。

sentences.en: I think he simply made judicial errors.
sentences.zh: 我认为他只是犯了司法错误。

sentences.en: There's a reaction from the pharmaceutical industry.
sentences.zh: 制药行业也有反应。

sentences.en: More than 600 drug makers and biotech leaders signing on to a scathing condemnation of that ruling by a federal judge in Texas.
sentences.zh: 超过600家制药商和生物技术领袖签署了一份声明，严厉谴责了这位德克萨斯州联邦法官的裁决。

sentences.en: Which is terrified not only about this abortion bill.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅对这种堕胎药感到恐惧。

sentences.en: If one medicine is subject to this kind of outcome, really any medicine is.
sentences.zh: 如果一种药物会受到这种结果的影响，那么实际上任何药物都可能受到影响。

sentences.en: But about the idea that judges all across America are going to be second-guessing the FDA's approval of other drugs.
sentences.zh: 他们更担心的是，全美的法官都将开始质疑FDA对其他药物的批准。

sentences.en: Providers are once again scrambling.
sentences.zh: 医疗服务提供者再次陷入了混乱。

sentences.en: At issue, use of a key abortion medication after two conflicting court opinions.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，在两份相互冲突的法院意见之后，关键堕胎药物的使用问题。

sentences.en: There is also, on the same night that the Texas judge rules, a ruling from a judge in Washington state that goes in precisely the opposite direction
sentences.zh: 同样在德克萨斯法官做出裁决的当晚，华盛顿州的一位法官也做出了一项裁决，其方向截然相反，

sentences.en: and says that in 17 states and the District of Columbia, the FDA may not suspend approval of the drug, must keep the drug in place.
sentences.zh: 称在17个州和哥伦比亚特区，FDA不得暂停对该药的批准，必须维持该药的供应。

sentences.en: Now the two competing rulings set up a high-stakes legal showdown that's likely to end up before the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在，这两项相互竞争的裁决引发了一场高风险的法律对决，很可能会最终提交到美国

sentences.en: Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 最高法院。

sentences.en: So now there's contradictory rulings in the land.
sentences.zh: 所以现在国内出现了相互矛盾的裁决。

sentences.en: The Biden administration immediately goes to an appeals court, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府立即向一家上诉法院提起上诉，即位于新奥尔良的美国

sentences.en: Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit in New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 第五巡回上诉法院。

sentences.en: Today, the Justice Department appealed a federal judge's ruling asking for an emergency stay.
sentences.zh: 今天，司法部对一位联邦法官的裁决提出上诉，要求紧急暂缓执行。

sentences.en: And says, please stop that seven-day deadline.
sentences.zh: 并说，请停止那个七天的最后期限。

sentences.en: Please let us litigate this in an orderly fashion.
sentences.zh: 请让我们以有序的方式进行诉讼。

sentences.en: And how does the Fifth Circuit respond?
sentences.zh: 第五巡回法院是如何回应的？

sentences.en: So the question before the Fifth Circuit is what to do while the appeal goes forward.
sentences.zh: 所以第五巡回法院面临的问题是在上诉进行期间该怎么做。

sentences.en: And to the surprise of almost everybody, it issues a kind of mixed decision.
sentences.zh: 令几乎所有人惊讶的是，它发布了一个混合裁决。

sentences.en: It says, we're not going to go back to 2000.
sentences.zh: 它说，我们不会回到2000年。

sentences.en: That's too far back.
sentences.zh: 那太久远了。

sentences.en: The statute of limitations has passed.
sentences.zh: 诉讼时效已经过了。

sentences.en: We are going to maintain the FDA's approval of the drug.
sentences.zh: 我们将维持FDA对该药的批准。

sentences.en: And we're not going to recreate the world of before 2000, where this drug was not yet approved as safe and effective.
sentences.zh: 我们不会重现2000年之前那种该药尚未被批准为安全有效的情况。

sentences.en: But we are going to go back to 2016.
sentences.zh: 但我们将回到2016年。

sentences.en: And in 2016, and in later years, the FDA gradually expanded access to the drug.
sentences.zh: 而在2016年及以后的几年里，FDA逐渐扩大了对该药的使用权限。

sentences.en: It made it available up through 10 weeks of pregnancy versus the original seven.
sentences.zh: 它将适用范围从最初的怀孕7周扩大到了10周。

sentences.en: It required fewer visits to a doctor.
sentences.zh: 它减少了就医次数要求。

sentences.en: It allowed other health care professionals to prescribe it.
sentences.zh: 它允许其他医疗专业人员开具处方。

sentences.en: And it allowed the drug to be mailed.
sentences.zh: 它还允许通过邮寄方式获取该药。

sentences.en: All of that, the Fifth Circuit said, could be suspended.
sentences.zh: 第五巡回法院表示，所有这些都可以被暂停。

sentences.en: So they didn't take the world back to 2000, but they took the world back to 2016.
sentences.zh: 所以他们没有让世界回到2000年，但他们让世界回到了2016年。

sentences.en: So just to be sure I understand, whereas the Texas judge, during this interim period, wants to roll back the clock on mifepristone all the way back to 2000,
sentences.zh: 为了确保我理解正确，德克萨斯州的法官在此过渡期间希望将米非司酮的状况一路回拨到2000年，

sentences.en: to a world before the FDA even approves this drug, the Fifth Circuit says, no, something more modest is in order.
sentences.zh: 回到FDA甚至还没批准该药的世界，而第五巡回法院则表示，不，需要更温和一点的措施。

sentences.en: We're going to roll back the clock to before 2016, when access to this drug was expanded.
sentences.zh: 我们将把时间回拨到2016年之前，即该药的使用权限扩大之前。

sentences.en: So the world we're going to be living in right now is going to be one where mifepristone is available, but just not as available as it has been.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在要生活的世界将是米非司酮仍然可用，但不再像以前那样容易获取。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I suppose the Fifth Circuit thought that was a compromise of some sort.
sentences.zh: 我想第五巡回法院认为这是一种妥协。

sentences.en: But not everyone agreed.
sentences.zh: 但并非所有人都同意。

sentences.en: I'm curious, Adam, what do you make of the fact that we now, in this legal saga, have two federal courts, one on the district level, the other on the appeals level,
sentences.zh: 亚当，我很好奇，对于我们现在在这场法律传奇中拥有两家联邦法院，一家在地区层面，另一家在上诉层面，

sentences.en: going outside what, in your description, is the typical path of leaving access to a drug like this untouched as a case winds its way through the system?
sentences.zh: 偏离了你所描述的典型路径——即在案件审理过程中保持对这类药物的获取途径不受影响——你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: So let me start by saying that there's almost nothing typical about this case, and this is the first time, to anyone's knowledge,
sentences.zh: 首先我想说，这个案件几乎没有什么典型之处，而且据任何人所知，这是第一次

sentences.en: that a court has overruled the FDA's approval of any drug of any kind.
sentences.zh: 有法院推翻了FDA对任何药物的批准。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And not to be simple-minded about it, but at least some legal observers note that the Texas judge
sentences.zh: 而且，虽然不想把问题简单化，但至少有一些法律观察家指出，德克萨斯州的法官

sentences.en: and the judges in the majority in the Fifth Circuit were all appointed by Donald Trump, who had vowed to appoint judges who were prepared to overrule Roe v.
sentences.zh: 以及第五巡回法院多数派中的法官都是由唐纳德·特朗普任命的，他曾誓言要任命那些准备推翻“罗诉韦德案”

sentences.en: Wade and who were opposed to abortion.
sentences.zh: 并反对堕胎的法官。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So against that backdrop, what, Adam, happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么在这样的背景下，亚当，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, the Biden administration can't live with this supposed compromise from the Fifth Circuit, and it goes to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 嗯，拜登政府无法接受第五巡回法院这种所谓的妥协，于是它向最高法院提起上诉。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court, the Supreme Court, that just last June said that it was getting out of the abortion business.
sentences.zh: 最高法院，那个就在去年六月还说它要退出堕胎事务的最高法院。

sentences.en: But that turned out to be wrong.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明那是错的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning, and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接听了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.zh: 今天，我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 Super Sundays.
sentences.zh: 60个超级星期天。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎每年都是联盟中最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.

And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.

sentences.en: So, Adam, what does the Supreme Court, which, as you said, doesn't really want to have to be involved in this kind of a case, but now has had its hand forced, what does it do?
sentences.zh: 那么，亚当，最高法院——正如你所说，它并不真的想卷入这种案件，但现在被迫出手了——它会怎么做？

sentences.en: Well, Michael, remember that one-week pause that the judge in Texas imposed?
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，还记得德克萨斯州法官强加的那一周暂停期吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Justice Samuel Alito says he's going to extend that pause just for a couple days to give the Supreme Court enough time to read briefs, to get on top of the lower court decisions,
sentences.zh: 塞缪尔·阿利托大法官表示，他将把暂停令延长几天，以便最高法院有足够的时间阅读案情摘要，了解下级法院的裁决，

sentences.en: and make a decision.
sentences.zh: 并做出决定。

sentences.en: And he sets a new deadline tonight at midnight.
sentences.zh: 他将新的截止日期定在今晚午夜。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, what exactly will we know by midnight tonight?
sentences.zh: 那么，到今晚午夜我们究竟会知道些什么？

sentences.en: What is the scope of what we expect the Supreme Court to decide, given all these conflicting cases and this legal saga that has led us to this point?
sentences.zh: 考虑到所有这些相互矛盾的案件以及导致我们走到这一步的法律纠葛，我们预期最高法院裁决的范围是什么？

sentences.en: So, let me start by saying the Supreme Court can do whatever it likes, but I'll tell you what the likely outcomes are.
sentences.zh: 首先，我想说最高法院可以随心所欲，但我可以告诉你可能的结果是什么。

sentences.en: One thing the court's not going to do tonight is decide on the merits of whether Judge Kaczmarek was right or wrong.
sentences.zh: 法院今晚绝对不会做的一件事，就是裁定卡兹马雷克法官的判决是对是错。

sentences.en: The court will almost certainly get to that question down the line, maybe months from now.
sentences.zh: 法院几乎肯定会在未来某个时候处理这个问题，也许是几个月后。

sentences.en: For now, all the court is going to decide is what happens in the meantime while the case goes forward.
sentences.zh: 目前，法院唯一要决定的是在案件审理期间会发生什么。

sentences.en: And it can basically do one of three things.
sentences.zh: 它基本上可以做三件事之一。

sentences.en: One is to say that the status quo we've lived with for 23 years remains in place and the pill remains available.
sentences.zh: 一是维持我们过去23年来一直保持的现状，即该药仍然可用。

sentences.en: The other is to say, as the Fifth Circuit did, that the relaxed standards after 2016 go away, but the pill is mostly available.
sentences.zh: 二是像第五巡回法院那样，取消2016年后的宽松标准，但该药大部分时间仍可获得。

sentences.en: And the third is to say that while the case goes forward, access to the pill is suspended and abortion becomes even more difficult to obtain in the United States.
sentences.zh: 三是宣布在案件审理期间，暂停获取该药，使得在美国获得堕胎服务变得更加困难。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Adam, this is, of course, a Supreme Court whose conservative majority is inclined to oppose abortion.
sentences.zh: 亚当，当然，这是一个保守派占多数、倾向于反对堕胎的最高法院。

sentences.en: I don't think there's any debate about that.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一点毫无争议。

sentences.en: But as you hinted at earlier, in its biggest ruling of all on abortion,
sentences.zh: 但正如你之前所暗示的，在它关于堕胎最重大的裁决中，

sentences.en: made clear that it wants elected officials to be deciding access to abortion rather than the judiciary issuing a kind of one-size-fits-all nationwide policy.
sentences.zh: 它明确表示希望由民选官员来决定堕胎的获取途径，而不是由司法机构发布一种“一刀切”的全国性政策。

sentences.en: So which of these three outcomes that you just went through seems most consistent with this Supreme Court's approach to abortion?
sentences.zh: 那么，在你刚才提到的这三种结果中，哪一种似乎最符合最高法院处理堕胎问题的方式？

sentences.en: Well, if we take the court at its word in Dobbs, it claimed to be scrupulously neutral about abortion.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果我们相信法院在“多布斯案”中的说辞，它声称对堕胎问题保持审慎的中立。

sentences.en: It wasn't pro-abortion.
sentences.zh: 它不是支持堕胎。

sentences.en: It wasn't anti-abortion.
sentences.zh: 它也不是反对堕胎。

sentences.en: It just said the Constitution has nothing to say about it and the court was going to stay out of things.
sentences.zh: 它只是说宪法对此没有规定，法院将置身事外。

sentences.en: If that vow is to be taken seriously,
sentences.zh: 如果这个誓言是认真的，

sentences.en: you would think the court would defer to the expert agency in this area and its review of the science and certainly just while the case proceeds,
sentences.zh: 你会认为法院会尊重该领域的专家机构及其对科学的审查，并且至少在案件审理期间，

sentences.en: allow access to the pill to continue.
sentences.zh: 允许继续获取该药。

sentences.en: So basically leave it as it was post-2016, full access to this pill, at least in the states where abortion remains legal.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上维持2016年后的状态，至少在堕胎仍然合法的州，可以完全获取这种药。

sentences.en: That's what the logic of Dobbs would suggeSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是“多布斯案”逻辑所暗示的。

sentences.en: But of course, at least some of the justices may have been animated not by scrupulous neutrality toward abortion, but by actual opposition to abortion.
sentences.zh: 但当然，至少有一些大法官可能不是出于对堕胎的审慎中立，而是出于对堕胎的实际反对。

sentences.en: So I might expect a split decision with the most conservative justices, justices Clarence Thomas, Samuel Alito, and Neil Gorsuch may be off on one end.
sentences.zh: 所以我可能会预料到一个分裂的判决，最保守的大法官，克拉伦斯·托马斯、塞缪尔·阿利托和尼尔·戈萨奇可能站在一端。

sentences.en: The three liberal justices, Justice Sonia Sotomayor, Elena Kagan, and Ketanji Brown-Jackson off on the other end.
sentences.zh: 三位自由派大法官，索尼娅·索托马约尔、埃琳娜·卡根和凯坦吉·布朗-杰克逊站在另一端。

sentences.en: And then the middle of the court being decisive, Chief Justice Roberts, Justice Brett Kavanaugh, and Justice Amy Coney Barrett.
sentences.zh: 而法院的中坚力量将起决定性作用，即首席大法官罗伯茨、布雷特·卡瓦诺大法官和艾米·科尼·巴雷特大法官。

sentences.en: And I think some coalition of the liberals plus the Chief Justice plus Justice Kavanaugh might be enough to maintain, for the time being,
sentences.zh: 我认为自由派加上首席大法官和卡瓦诺大法官的某种联盟可能足以在目前维持，

sentences.en: the status quo allowing unfettered access to the pill as we've had since 2000.
sentences.zh: 维持现状，允许像自2000年以来那样不受限制地获取该药。

sentences.en: And let's presume, Adam, that your prediction here is correct,
sentences.zh: 亚当，让我们假设你的预测是正确的，

sentences.en: and a coalition of liberal and conservative justices comes together and ensures unfettered access to Mifepristone for now.
sentences.zh: 自由派和保守派大法官的联盟走到了一起，确保了目前对米非司酮不受限制的获取。

sentences.en: What will that tell us about how the justices are likely to rule on this even larger and more consequential question of whether this Texas judge's ruling has merit?
sentences.zh: 这会告诉我们大法官们可能会如何裁决这个更大、更具影响的问题，即这位德克萨斯州法官的裁决是否有理？

sentences.en: That the FDA was wrong when it approved this drug back in 2000, and that it should be banned.
sentences.zh: 即FDA在2000年批准这种药物时是错误的，应该予以禁止。

sentences.en: So they're not the same questions.
sentences.zh: 所以它们不是同一个问题。

sentences.en: They don't involve identical legal standards.
sentences.zh: 它们不涉及相同的法律标准。

sentences.en: But nonetheless, as a practical matter, the vote on this initial question will be powerfully predictive of the vote on the ultimate question.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，从实际角度来看，对这个初步问题的投票将有力地预测最终问题的投票。

sentences.en: Meaning that if I'm right, and we'll find out soon enough, abortion opponents are likely, in the short term but also in the long term, to suffer a setback.
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果我是对的，而且我们很快就会知道，堕胎反对者在短期内，甚至长期内，都可能遭受挫折。

sentences.en: But it's important to consider the context.
sentences.zh: 但考虑背景很重要。

sentences.en: They won a huge victory on a constitutional question in the Dobbs decision.
sentences.zh: 他们在“多布斯案”的宪法问题上赢得了巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: This is a different question, a question of administrative law.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不同的问题，一个行政法的问题。

sentences.en: It was a very ambitious claim to begin with.
sentences.zh: 这起初就是一个非常有野心的主张。

sentences.en: They found a sympathetic judge who produced a not particularly satisfying opinion.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了一位同情的法官，他写出了一份并不特别令人满意的意见书。

sentences.en: And they can't have been all that confident that they could ultimately win on the merits of this case.
sentences.zh: 他们不可能那么确信自己最终能在案件的实质问题上获胜。

sentences.en: And whatever the justices' sympathies are on abortion, they also have some commitment to judicial craftsmanship.
sentences.zh: 无论大法官们在堕胎问题上有什么同情心，他们也对司法工艺有一定的承诺。

sentences.en: And maintaining commitments to legal doctrines like standing and the statute of limitations and how administrative law works.
sentences.zh: 并保持对法律原则的承诺，如诉讼资格、诉讼时效以及行政法如何运作。

sentences.en: And legal experts say that Judge Kaczmarek's opinion flunked all of that.
sentences.zh: 法律专家表示，卡兹马雷克法官的意见书在所有这些方面都不合格。

sentences.en: And the Fifth Circuit's opinion was a little better.
sentences.zh: 第五巡回法院的意见书稍微好一点。

sentences.en: So while people have lost a lot of faith in the Supreme Court,
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然人们对最高法院失去了很多信心，

sentences.en: they still hope and expect that a majority of the justices are committed to neutral legal principles that would make this kind of case difficult to sustain.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然希望并期待大多数大法官致力于中立的法律原则，这将使这类案件难以维持。

sentences.en: So these two questions of what to do about Mifepristone both in the short term and the long term could ultimately reveal the limits of this Supreme Court's conservatism when it comes to abortion.
sentences.zh: 因此，关于米非司酮在短期和长期内该怎么办的这两个问题，最终可能会揭示最高法院在堕胎问题上保守主义的局限性。

sentences.en: There may be a place that it just won't go.
sentences.zh: 可能有一个它绝对不会触碰的底线。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, there are outcomes that many of the justices might like, but they need to have a pathway to those outcomes that looks like law, not politics.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，有很多结果是许多大法官可能喜欢的，但他们需要有一条通往这些结果的路径，看起来像法律，而不是政治。

sentences.en: And this doesn't look like that pathway?
sentences.zh: 而这看起来不像那条路径？

sentences.en: No, it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 不，不像。

sentences.en: And while the court is full of surprises, this is a moment in time when it's in the midst of a legitimacy crisis.
sentences.zh: 虽然法院总是充满惊喜，但现在正处于合法性危机的关头。

sentences.en: Its public approval ratings have plummeted.
sentences.zh: 它的公众支持率已经暴跌。

sentences.en: There are almost daily revelations about apparent ethics violations, notably by Justice Clarence Thomas.
sentences.zh: 几乎每天都有关于明显违反道德行为的披露，特别是克拉伦斯·托马斯大法官。

sentences.en: And it's probably not the moment for them to endorse legal theories that all kinds of serious people, conservatives and liberals both,
sentences.zh: 现在可能不是他们支持那些各种严肃人士，无论是保守派还是自由派，

sentences.en: think are borderline crazy and would do more than affect abortions.
sentences.zh: 都认为近乎疯狂且影响远不止堕胎的法律理论的时候。

sentences.en: It would undermine the ability of the Food and Drug Administration to set national standards for safe and effective drugs.
sentences.zh: 这将削弱食品药品监督管理局制定安全有效药物国家标准的能力。

sentences.en: It would allow anybody with an objection to a vaccine or something else to go into court and have a single federal district judge untrained in science to second guess the approvals of the expert agency.
sentences.zh: 这将允许任何对疫苗或其他东西有异议的人进入法院，让一位没有受过科学训练的联邦地区法官去质疑专家机构的批准。

sentences.en: So just as the FDA does a cost-benefit analysis of whether to approve a drug or not, the court has to do a kind of cost-benefit analysis too.
sentences.zh: 所以，正如FDA对是否批准一种药物进行成本效益分析一样，法院也必须进行某种成本效益分析。

sentences.en: It may like a particular result, but it has to think of the cost of the collateral consequences.
sentences.zh: 它可能喜欢某个特定的结果，但它必须考虑附带后果的成本。

sentences.en: And the consequences here would be enormous.
sentences.zh: 而这里的后果将是巨大的。

sentences.en: Right, because the cost might not just be the court's legitimacy in the eyes of many Americans, because it would be endorsing what looks like an ideologically driven,
sentences.zh: 没错，因为代价可能不仅仅是法院在许多美国人心中的合法性，因为它将支持一种看起来是意识形态驱动的、

sentences.en: legally shaky ruling on a subject the court has said it doesn't want to touch anymore.
sentences.zh: 法律上站不住脚的裁决，而法院已经表示不想再触碰这个话题了。

sentences.en: It could also imperil an enormous component of the American health care system.
sentences.zh: 它还可能危及美国医疗体系的一个巨大组成部分。

sentences.en: And those are two costs that might make the justices inclined to show some real restraint here.
sentences.zh: 这两个代价可能会使大法官们倾向于在这里表现出一些真正的克制。

sentences.en: Yes, so this is a court that is assertive and ambitious and has an agenda, and that agenda may even include trying to further restrict abortion,
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个自信、有野心且有议程的法院，这个议程甚至可能包括试图进一步限制堕胎，

sentences.en: notwithstanding what seemed to be a promise in the Dobbs decision.
sentences.zh: 尽管这似乎违背了“多布斯案”裁决中的承诺。

sentences.en: But even so, you would think these are sensible, able judges who would want to pick their shots.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，你还是会认为这些是明智、有能力的法官，他们会想选择时机。

sentences.en: And maybe not, in this particular case, where there are the questions you've raised, Michael, take an enormous step at the cost of imperiling its prestige, authority,
sentences.zh: 也许在这种特殊情况下，迈克尔，当你提出的问题存在时，他们不会采取巨大的步骤，以牺牲其声望、权威和合法性为代价，

sentences.en: legitimacy in an era where it's under all kinds of scrutiny and assault.
sentences.zh: 在一个它受到各种审查和攻击的时代。

sentences.en: As always, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一《Connections》，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我也喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责创建《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的事情。

sentences.en: In a dramatic and surprise ending to what was expected to be a blockbuster defamation trial, Fox News reached a nearly $800 million settlement with Dominion Voting Systems,
sentences.zh: 在一场本应是重磅诽谤审判的戏剧性且令人惊讶的结局中，福克斯新闻与Dominion投票系统公司达成了近8亿美元的和解，

sentences.en: which had accused the network of knowingly spreading false claims about its role in election fraud in the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 该公司指控该电视网在2020年大选中明知故犯地散布关于其在选举舞弊中角色的虚假声明。

sentences.en: The last-minute settlement was announced after a jury had been selected, and opening statements from both sides were about to start.
sentences.zh: 这项最后一刻的和解是在陪审团选定、双方即将开始开庭陈述后宣布的。

sentences.en: Dominion had originally demanded $1.6 billion from Fox.
sentences.zh: Dominion最初向福克斯索赔16亿美元。

sentences.en: But even with a settlement that fell short of that, Dominion's lawyers called the outcome a major victory for the company and the truth.
sentences.zh: 但即使和解金额未达预期，Dominion的律师仍称这一结果对公司和真相来说是一场重大胜利。

sentences.en: Today's settlement of $787,500,000 represents vindication and accountability.
sentences.zh: 今天7.875亿美元的和解代表了正义的伸张和问责。

sentences.en: Lies have consequences.
sentences.zh: 谎言是有代价的。

sentences.en: The truth does not know red or blue.
sentences.zh: 真相不分红蓝。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 周二，

sentences.en: a Russian court rejected an effort by a Wall Street Journal reporter to end his detention while he awaits trial on charges of espionage that both his employer and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯一家法院驳回了一名《华尔街日报》记者在等待间谍罪审判期间结束拘留的请求，他的雇主和美国

sentences.en: government say are entirely baseless.
sentences.zh: 政府都表示这些指控完全是毫无根据的。

sentences.en: The rejection came during a hearing in which the reporter, Evan Gerskovich, appeared in public for the first time since his arreSt.
sentences.zh: 驳回是在一场听证会上做出的，该记者埃文·格什科维奇自被捕以来首次公开露面。

sentences.en: His detention, the first time a Western journalist has been charged with espionage since the Cold War, has brought relations between the United States and Russia to a new low.
sentences.zh: 他的拘留是自冷战以来首次有西方记者被控间谍罪，这使美俄关系降至新低。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Nina Feldman and Alex Stern, with help from Michael Simon-Johnson.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由尼娜·费尔德曼和亚历克斯·斯特恩制作，迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Chow and Devin Taylor, contains original music by Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由丽莎·周和德文·泰勒编辑，包含丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lantzfork of Winderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Winderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰茨福克创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Pam Bellick.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢帕姆·贝利克。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《The Daily》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Balboro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔博罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《The Wirecutter Show》节目中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一件非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何收听平台上找到《The Wirecutter Show》。
